test.create_query: CREATE TABLE top_k_learned (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO top_k_learned SELECT if(number % 10 < 3, concat('spread_', toString(intHash32(number) % 200)), concat('u', toString(number))) FROM numbers(14000000)
INSERT INTO top_k_learned SELECT concat('hidden_', toString(intDiv(number, 60000))) FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT k, count() AS c FROM top_k_learned GROUP BY k ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
